title: Notice Periods Timetable — LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy
content:
The LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy runs on fixed notice periods, the same on all six tiers. They govern when a nonpayment notice is issued, how far a cancellation is scheduled from its notice, the advance notice owed before nonrenewal, and the advance notice owed to a mortgagee.

## Timetable (calendar days)

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum advance notice of nonrenewal before expiration | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days past due after which a nonpayment notice is issued | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Days from a nonpayment notice to the scheduled cancellation date | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Days from an underwriting cancellation notice to the scheduled cancellation date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Advance notice of cancellation owed to the mortgagee | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## The same periods in words

- Nonrenewal: at least 30 calendar days before the expiration date.
- Nonpayment: a notice once an installment is unpaid more than 15 calendar days after its due date, with the cancellation scheduled 10 calendar days after the notice.
- Underwriting cancellation: the cancellation is scheduled 30 calendar days after the notice.
- Mortgagee: 10 calendar days of advance notice of cancellation.

## Hypothetical illustration

A nonpayment notice issued on a hypothetical 1 March schedules the cancellation for 11 March, 10 calendar days later. An underwriting cancellation notice issued on the same day schedules the cancellation for 31 March, 30 calendar days later.
